# Column — Style Reference

> Navy ink typeset on bank ledger paper, one orange receipt on the desk. Suisse Intl and SF Mono print on a #ffffff and #f6f6f8 canvas, hairlines stay at 12% grey, and #ec652b appears once per scene.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Column speaks a ledger-and-terminal product language: a bank that illustrates itself with its own API payloads. The canvas is Paper Canvas #ffffff alternating with Fog Surface #f6f6f8. Frosted panes at #ffffffbf and #ffffff80 float over halftone dot maps, and an inverted navy #111a4a is reserved for the single primary action. The chromatic budget is two system hues. Forest Signal #167e6c marks eyebrows and stat figures, and Ember Receipt #ec652b marks one highlighted object per section, while syntax colors and dot-art blues stay decorative. Typography is the thesis. SF Mono renders 667 elements against 349 for Suisse Intl, so monospace is the majority voice and the sans is the editorial overlay. Headlines sit at 600 with -0.03em tracking at 52px, the lead paragraph drops to 300, and navy-versus-grey ink carries hierarchy more than size jumps do. Shape is a near-uniform 8px, and elevation is a stack of navy-tinted micro-shadows that stay at or under 0.25 alpha. The page reads as a bank's operations console rather than a bank's brochure.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background, mega-menu panel, testimonial panel and code payload sheet. It is the white sheet the ledger is printed on, and it keeps every navy stroke crisp. |
| Fog Surface | `#f6f6f8` | `--color-fog-surface` | Alternating section background, active mega-menu row and the menu preview tile (22 uses). It is a 3% cool shift that separates zones without a single border. |
| Frosted Pane | `#ffffffbf` | `--color-frosted-pane` | Glass account cards floating over dot maps, paired with blur(12px). Translucency lets the halftone art read through, so the data feels layered in space. |
| Frosted Veil | `#ffffff80` | `--color-frosted-veil` | Secondary buttons such as Get started, Documentation and Learn about our bank, with blur(2px). The 50% white lets these buttons sit on gradients without becoming solid blocks. |
| Ink Wash | `#111a4a08` | `--color-ink-wash` | Product chips, eyebrow badges and subtle fills (17 uses). It is navy at 3% alpha rather than grey, so even tints stay inside the brand ink family. |
| Jet Nav | `#12161e` | `--color-jet-nav` | Navigation links, mega-menu items and the Sign in link (23 uses). It is the darkest neutral and is kept for wayfinding text that must read instantly. |
| Ink Navy | `#111a4a` | `--color-ink-navy` | Headlines, lead paragraphs, the Sign up fill and account balances (67 text uses). It replaces black across the system and gives every page a banknote tint. |
| Graphite Label | `#232730` | `--color-graphite-label` | Text on frosted secondary buttons (6 uses). It is a neutral charcoal that keeps glass buttons quieter than the navy primary. Do not use it for headlines. |
| Slate Caption | `#7c7f88` | `--color-slate-caption` | Stat captions, menu group labels, attributions and body copy in feature sections (275 uses, the most-used text color). It is the workhorse secondary ink. |
| Ash Tertiary | `#a9acb6` | `--color-ash-tertiary` | The grey continuation of two-tone headlines, quote marks and de-emphasized metadata (76 uses). It turns half a sentence into supporting voice without changing the size. |
| Quartz Border | `#e3e4e8` | `--color-quartz-border` | Eyebrow underline rules and the few true 1px borders on light surfaces. Hairlines here are dividers, not containers, which is why they are rare. |
| Forest Signal | `#167e6c` | `--color-forest-signal` | Stat figures, the TRUSTED AT SCALE eyebrow text and inline links (44 fills). It reads as a ledger credit and signals proof. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Ember Receipt | `#ec652b` | `--color-ember-receipt` | Active carousel logo tab and the highlighted balance card (6 fills). It is rationed to one object per scene. Do not use it for buttons, text or full-section backgrounds. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Suisse Intl — the editorial overlay for headlines, navigation and prose · `--font-suisse-intl`

- **Substitute:** Inter (variable) at 600 for headlines, 500 for UI and 350 for the 300 lead; Geist at 600 / 500 / 400 for the lead. Suisse Intl Light draws slightly heavier than its 300 number, closer to a 350, so do not drop a substitute to a true 300 or the lead paragraph thins out.
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 28px, 40px, 52px, 60px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.1, 1.375, 1.4, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -1.56px at 52px, -0.6px at 60px, -0.8px at 40px, -0.28px at 28px, -0.24px at 24px, -0.2px at 20px, -0.14px at 14px headings, 0px at 12–16px body
- **OpenType features:** `"salt" 2`
- **Role:** Weight 600 at 52–60px gives headlines a firm, banknote-plate density without the 700 shout most fintech heroes use. The lead paragraph then drops to 300 at 20px, so the hero has a deliberate loud-quiet pair. The scale climbs in near-Minor-Third steps (12→14→16→20→24→28, ratios 1.14–1.25) and then jumps 1.43 to 40px. Body sizes are tightly packed, and only display sizes leap. Tracking tightens in proportion to size, reaching -0.03em at 52px, which is the convention for grotesks pushed to display.

### SF Mono — the majority voice: payloads, figures and data art · `--font-sf-mono`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400, Geist Mono at 400. SF Mono at 10px draws lighter than these, so keep every substitute at 400 and do not use 500.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 10px, 12px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 10px, 0px at 12px
- **OpenType features:** `"cv11"`, `"salt" 2`
- **Role:** SF Mono renders 667 elements, nearly double Suisse Intl, which is anti-convention for a marketing page. The hero image is literally a JSON wire payload set at 10px and 12px. A single weight and no tracking make it read as machine output rather than designed type. That is the point: the bank's API response is its photography.

### Suisse Intl Mono — uppercase micro-labels that name each section · `--font-suisse-intl-mono`

- **Substitute:** IBM Plex Mono at 400, Geist Mono at 400
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px (uppercase)
- **OpenType features:** `"salt" 2`, `"cv11"`
- **Role:** Used only 7 times, it sets the eyebrow badges (TRUSTED AT SCALE, DEVELOPER FIRST) in uppercase at 12px. It bridges the editorial sans and the terminal mono, labelling each section like a field name in a schema. Inter (22 uses) also appears, but only inside product mockups and as mockup-internal type, not as a system family.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | SF Mono | 400 | 10px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Suisse Intl | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Suisse Intl | 500 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Suisse Intl | 400 | 16px | 1.375 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Suisse Intl | 300 | 20px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Suisse Intl | 500 | 24px | 1.1 | -0.24px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Suisse Intl | 500 | 28px | 1.1 | -0.28px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Suisse Intl | 500 | 40px | 1.1 | -0.8px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Suisse Intl | 600 | 52px | 1.1 | -1.56px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Suisse Intl | 600 | 60px | 1.0 | -0.6px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in #111a4a at weight 600 for 52–60px and weight 500 for 24–40px — navy ink is the brand's black, and the weight drop below 52px keeps section titles subordinate to the hero.
- Use the 10px or 12px SF Mono payload as hero imagery, in place of photography — monospace is the majority voice (667 elements), and the bank's API output is its self-portrait.
- Write two-tone headlines with the claim in #111a4a and the continuation in #a9acb6 at the same 28px size — hierarchy comes from ink value, not from a second, smaller line.
- Keep buttons, cards, chips and menu rows at 8px radius — the shape is set once, so only the 6px Ember card, the 12px section panel and the 9999px dots carry meaning as exceptions.
- Spend Ember Receipt #ec652b on exactly one object per section — one orange item per scene is non-negotiable, because a second dilutes the receipt into a theme color.
- Tint shadows and washes with navy, as in rgba(17, 26, 74, 0.1) and #111a4a08 — the tinted shadows keep elevation inside the ink family instead of reading as generic grey.
- Separate sections with 144px of space and a #f6f6f8 background shift — tonal steps and air divide the page, and hairlines at #e3e4e8 underline eyebrows only.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary button with #167e6c or #ec652b — the CTA is #111a4a by design, and a colored CTA turns the console into a checkout page.
- Don't swap the hero JSON for a photograph or 3D render of cards and coins — the thesis is that the bank's picture of itself is its API payload, and stock imagery reads as a consumer neobank.
- Don't set headlines at weight 700 with 0px tracking — Column's 600 at -1.56px is dense but measured, and 700 shouts like a retail promotion.
- Don't use #000000 or #12161e for headlines — #12161e is wayfinding ink for 14px nav, and black removes the banknote tint that #111a4a gives every claim.
- Don't box the stat row in bordered cards with icons — 24px #167e6c figures on bare canvas read as ledger lines, and containers turn them into dashboard widgets.
- Don't add 1px #e3e4e8 borders around cards — edges come from the inset white ring and shadows at 0.1 alpha, and bordered cards read as a form, not floating glass.
- Never set paragraphs in SF Mono — the mono is reserved for 10–12px payloads and figures, and mono body copy at 16px turns the editorial overlay into a README.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f6f6f8 (Fog Surface)
- headline and body ink: #111a4a (Ink Navy)
- secondary text: #7c7f88 (Slate Caption)
- tertiary and headline continuation: #a9acb6 (Ash Tertiary)
- proof accent: #167e6c (Forest Signal)
- primary action: #111a4a (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs are drawn as dot matrices and thin bars in a single hue at full strength for data points and at 20–40% opacity for trails over a #f6f6f8 or #ffffff ground, so one series per chart carries color and #ec652b stays reserved for the single highlighted object.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a hero section on #ffffff with a 1112px max-width container split into two columns. In the left column, stack a 4px-radius badge, then an h1 "Move, hold, and lend the dollar at scale" in Suisse Intl (fallback Inter) weight 600 at 52px, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -1.56px, color #111a4a, then a lead paragraph at 20px weight 300, line-height 1.4, color #111a4a, max-width 440px, then a row with an 8px gap holding a primary and a secondary button. In the right column, place a #ffffff sheet 320px wide with a 4px radius and the shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0 40px 32px, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 0 22px 18px, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 0 12px 10px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0 7px 5px, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 0 3px 2px`, containing a JSON object in SF Mono 400 at 10px, line-height 1.5, keys in #111a4a, fading to transparent over the bottom 120px.
2. Create a Primary Action Button: background #111a4a, text #ffffff, Suisse Intl 500 at 16px, line-height 1, height 36px, padding 0 16px, border-radius 8px, no border, a trailing 12px chevron with an 8px gap, and box-shadow `rgb(17,26,74) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 2px 4px, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 1px 2px`. Pair it with a secondary button: background #ffffff80, backdrop-filter blur(2px), text #232730, same size and radius, shadow `rgba(255,255,255,0) 0 1px 1px, rgba(87,90,100,0.12) 0 0 0 1px`.
3. Build a glass account card 360px wide: background #ffffffbf, backdrop-filter blur(12px), border-radius 8px, padding 20px, box-shadow `rgb(255,255,255) 0 0 0 1px inset`, no border. Inside, place a top row with "Operating Account ••• 9921" in Suisse Intl 400 at 12px, color #7c7f88, then 8px below, "-$48,920.21 USD" in Suisse Intl 600 at 16px, color #111a4a. Add 12px below a row of chips (background #111a4a08, text #111a4a at 12px weight 500, radius 8px, padding 4px 8px). Float the card over a halftone dot pattern.
4. Build the navigation bar: 62px tall, transparent, position relative, max-width 1112px. Put the wordmark on the left, links "Products", "Developers", "Blog" and "Company" in the center as buttons with text #12161e at 14px Suisse Intl 500, padding 8px 16px and radius 8px, and "Sign in" plus a Frosted Veil "Get started" button on the right. The Products trigger opens a #ffffff panel with a 12px radius and shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.024) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0 16px 32px, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 4px 8px`. The panel holds three columns of 212px × 34px rows (padding 7px 8px, radius 8px, hover background #f6f6f8) under 12px #7c7f88 group labels with 1px #e3e4e8 rules.
5. Build a stat row of four equal columns inside 1112px with a 24px gap and no cards or borders. Each column holds a figure in Suisse Intl 500 at 24px, letter-spacing -0.24px, line-height 1.1, color #167e6c, then 4px below a caption in Suisse Intl 400 at 12px, line-height 1.1, color #7c7f88.

## Components

### Announcement Bar

**Role:** Full-bleed launch message above navigation

Thin and centered. The bar fills the viewport width in a mid-blue (#4575cd, decorative, not a system token) with #ffffff text at 14px Suisse Intl 500, a Frosted Veil-tinted "Watch the keynote" link and a chevron, roughly 40px tall (estimated) with 8px vertical padding and no radius or shadow. It is the only full-width saturated band on the page, so it reads as a newswire ticker rather than a promotional banner.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Transparent top bar, not sticky

Weightless and inline. The nav is 62px tall, positioned relative rather than sticky, and has no background over the hero gradient. The Column wordmark sits left, Products, Developers, Blog and Company sit center as 37px buttons (transparent fill, #12161e text, 14px Suisse Intl 500, 8px 16px padding, 8px radius), and Sign in plus a Frosted Veil Get started button sit right. With no fill and no bottom border, the hero runs to the top edge, which is unconventional for a bank that would normally anchor trust with a solid header.

### Mega-Menu Dropdown Panel

**Role:** Product catalogue in three columns

Dense and schema-like. The panel is #ffffff with a 12px radius and `--shadow-xl`. It holds three link columns with 12px #7c7f88 group labels over Quartz Border rules, rows that are 212px wide and 34px tall (#12161e at 14px Suisse Intl 500, 7px 8px padding, 8px radius, active row on #f6f6f8), and a #f6f6f8 preview tile with a 40px icon square, a 14px heading and 14px #7c7f88 description. It works like an API reference index, listing every product with equal weight.

### Primary Button — Navy Ink (Sign Up)

**Role:** The single filled call-to-action

Solid navy, deliberately not colorful. Background #111a4a, text #ffffff, no border, 8px radius, 0px 16px padding, 36px height, 16px Suisse Intl 500 at line-height 1.0, a trailing chevron, and `--shadow-md-2` (a 1px navy ring plus two 0.25-alpha drop layers). The primary action uses the headline ink rather than a brand hue, so the CTA carries the same weight as the claim above it. Use one per viewport.

### Secondary Button — Frosted Veil

**Role:** Documentation, learn-more and menu triggers

Glass, barely there. Background #ffffff80 with backdrop blur(2px), text #232730, no border, 8px radius, 0px 16px padding, 36px height, 16px Suisse Intl 500, and `--shadow-sm` (a 1px ring at 12% grey). It sits on dot maps and gradients without becoming an opaque block. Pair it to the right of the navy primary, or use it alone below section copy.

### Glass Account Card (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Floating account and transaction mockup

Translucent ledger slip. Background #ffffffbf with backdrop blur(12px), 8px radius, 20px padding, 360px wide, and `--shadow-subtle-2` (a 1px inset white ring as the only edge). It shows an "Operating Account ••• 9921" label in 12px #7c7f88 and an amount such as -$48,920.21 USD in 16px Suisse Intl 600 #111a4a. The inset white ring replaces a border, so the card reads as frosted glass catching light rather than a boxed widget.

### Ember Balance Card — System Outlier

**Role:** The one highlighted balance

The rationed hot object. Background #ec652b, 6px radius (the only 6px card), 20px padding, 320 × 145px, holding "$12,340,111.89 USD" with `--shadow-lg-2`. It breaks the 8px card rule and the navy-only fill rule on purpose. As the single saturated surface in its scene, it works as punctuation rather than decoration, and the tighter 6px radius makes it read as a physical card laid on the glass.

### Carousel Logo Tab — Ember (Active) and Plain (Idle)

**Role:** Customer story switcher

Wide, logo-led tabs. Each tab is 228–257px wide and 48px tall with 12px 32px padding, an 8px radius and 16px Suisse Intl 400 in #111a4a. The active tab fills with #ec652b and takes `--shadow-md-3` (inset bevel plus three soft drops), while idle tabs have no fill or shadow. Flanking 36px white circular arrows use an 18px radius and `--shadow-lg`. This is the second sanctioned Ember use, and each section allows exactly one orange object.

### Section Eyebrow Badge

**Role:** Mono uppercase section label

Schema field name. The badge uses Suisse Intl Mono 400 at 12px uppercase on #111a4a08 Ink Wash, with a 4px radius, 4px 8px padding (estimated) and text in #167e6c (TRUSTED AT SCALE) or #111a4a (DEVELOPER FIRST). A trailing block cursor glyph and a full-width 1px #e3e4e8 rule beneath complete it. It labels sections the way a JSON key labels a value, which is how the terminal voice enters the editorial layout.

### Product Chip

**Role:** Tags naming products used

Tactile mini-pills. Background #111a4a08, text #111a4a at 12px Suisse Intl 500, a 12px line icon at left, 8px radius, 4px 8px padding (estimated), and `--shadow-md` (a navy-tinted 1px drop with a white inner highlight). Chips wrap in rows with 8px gaps beneath case-study headlines. The inner highlight makes them read as pressed keys rather than flat labels.

### Stat Figure Row

**Role:** Four-column proof numbers

Ledger totals. Four columns hold figures such as $4.5T+ and 99.999% in #167e6c at 24px Suisse Intl 500 (-0.24px tracking, line-height 1.1), each over a 12px Suisse Intl 400 #7c7f88 caption at line-height 1.1, with no cards, borders or icons. Green figures on bare canvas read as account credits rather than marketing badges, which is unconventional where most fintech sites box their stats.

**Role:** Case study with quote

Wide and quiet. A #ffffff panel with a 12px radius (the only `sections` radius) sits on #f6f6f8 with `--shadow-subtle`. Inside is a 28px Suisse Intl 500 #111a4a headline, product chips, a #a9acb6 quote mark, a 20px Suisse Intl 500 quote in #111a4a and a 14px #7c7f88 attribution, with orange halftone dot art (decorative) filling the right half. The 12px radius marks it as a stage that holds other components.

**Role:** Hero JSON wire transfer

The brand's photograph. A #ffffff sheet about 320px wide with a 4px radius (estimated) and `--shadow-xl-2` (a five-layer long-throw drop) holds a full wire-transfer JSON object in SF Mono 400 at 10px with line-height 1.5. Keys are #111a4a and values use a mockup-internal syntax palette (#44b48b, #88deeb, #efaa65, #9f7aee, decorative, not system tokens). The payload fades to transparent at the bottom, so the API response is staged as an artifact rather than a code sample.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in #111a4a at weight 600 for 52–60px and weight 500 for 24–40px — navy ink is the brand's black, and the weight drop below 52px keeps section titles subordinate to the hero.
- Use the 10px or 12px SF Mono payload as hero imagery, in place of photography — monospace is the majority voice (667 elements), and the bank's API output is its self-portrait.
- Write two-tone headlines with the claim in #111a4a and the continuation in #a9acb6 at the same 28px size — hierarchy comes from ink value, not from a second, smaller line.
- Keep buttons, cards, chips and menu rows at 8px radius — the shape is set once, so only the 6px Ember card, the 12px section panel and the 9999px dots carry meaning as exceptions.
- Spend Ember Receipt #ec652b on exactly one object per section — one orange item per scene is non-negotiable, because a second dilutes the receipt into a theme color.
- Tint shadows and washes with navy, as in rgba(17, 26, 74, 0.1) and #111a4a08 — the tinted shadows keep elevation inside the ink family instead of reading as generic grey.
- Separate sections with 144px of space and a #f6f6f8 background shift — tonal steps and air divide the page, and hairlines at #e3e4e8 underline eyebrows only.

### Don't

- Don't fill the primary button with #167e6c or #ec652b — the CTA is #111a4a by design, and a colored CTA turns the console into a checkout page.
- Don't swap the hero JSON for a photograph or 3D render of cards and coins — the thesis is that the bank's picture of itself is its API payload, and stock imagery reads as a consumer neobank.
- Don't set headlines at weight 700 with 0px tracking — Column's 600 at -1.56px is dense but measured, and 700 shouts like a retail promotion.
- Don't use #000000 or #12161e for headlines — #12161e is wayfinding ink for 14px nav, and black removes the banknote tint that #111a4a gives every claim.
- Don't box the stat row in bordered cards with icons — 24px #167e6c figures on bare canvas read as ledger lines, and containers turn them into dashboard widgets.
- Don't add 1px #e3e4e8 borders around cards — edges come from the inset white ring and shadows at 0.1 alpha, and bordered cards read as a form, not floating glass.
- Never set paragraphs in SF Mono — the mono is reserved for 10–12px payloads and figures, and mono body copy at 16px turns the editorial overlay into a README.

## Imagery

Column uses no photography. The imagery is product artifacts and generative dot art. The hero pairs a halftone world map built from 50%-radius dots in mid-blue (#4575cd, decorative, not a system token) with a white JSON payload sheet set in 10px SF Mono and cast by a five-layer long shadow. Feature sections use dot-matrix bar charts in green (#44b48b and #3a5057, decorative), and the testimonial panel carries an orange halftone gradient behind the quote. Product mockups are frosted #ffffffbf cards with 12px blur and inset white rings, with no device frames. Icons are 12–16px single-weight line glyphs in #111a4a, set inside 8px-radius tiles. Gradients are decorative haze, not tokens. The narrative is infrastructure rendered as data: money appears as payloads, dots and ledger lines rather than as people holding phones.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1112px max-width column, and sections are separated by 144px (96–288px), often by switching between #ffffff and #f6f6f8. The hero splits in two. On the left, an FDIC badge, a 52px headline, a 20px weight-300 lead and the navy-plus-frosted button pair stack with 16–24px gaps. On the right, the code payload sheet overlaps the dot map. A single row of nine customer logos follows, then two-column feature blocks (copy left, dot chart or code right), a four-column stat row, and a full-width testimonial panel with a four-tab carousel. The mega menu runs three link columns plus a preview tile. The 62px nav is transparent and non-sticky, with the wordmark left, four links center, and Sign in plus Get started right. The footer falls outside the captured frames; build it on #f6f6f8 with 12px #7c7f88 link columns. At 375px, drop the hero to 40px and section gaps to 80px. Density: spacious.

## Payload As Imagery

The discipline is that the bank illustrates itself with its own output. SF Mono renders 667 elements against 349 for Suisse Intl, and the hero's largest visual is a JSON wire transfer at 10px rather than a photo or a card render. It breaks when someone adds lifestyle photography, glossy 3D coins, or reflows the payload in Suisse Intl to make it "friendlier", because the monospace stops reading as a real artifact. To extend the system, reach for another real artifact: a curl request, a webhook event or a ledger line, set in SF Mono at 10px or 12px with weight 400 and 0px tracking, framed on #ffffff with the long xl-2 shadow. New visuals should look like something the API returned.

## Navy Ink Discipline

Every claim on the page is printed in #111a4a, a navy that stands in for black, and the same ink fills the primary button and tints the shadows at rgba(17, 26, 74, 0.1). The system's single action color is therefore its headline color, which is anti-convention for fintech, where CTAs are usually a bright brand hue. It breaks when a designer introduces pure #000000 headlines, grey-tinted shadows on chips, or a green CTA. To extend it, derive tints from navy alpha (#111a4a08 for washes), use #a9acb6 for the de-emphasized half of a headline, and keep #12161e for 14px wayfinding only.

## Rationed Ember

Ember Receipt #ec652b is the system's only hot color, and it appears once per scene: the active Brex tab, the highlighted balance card, the orange halftone behind a quote. This rationing is what makes it read as a receipt laid on the desk rather than a brand wash. It breaks when orange becomes a second button style, a link color or a section background, or when two orange objects share a viewport. To extend it, choose the one item that represents the current or selected state, give it a 6px or 8px radius with the md-3 or lg-2 shadow, and keep everything around it navy, grey and white.
